summary: Desktop: opening a context chip's source. A Cmd+L quote chip stores the source chat and message ids (optional sourceConversationId and sourceMessageId on the draft pill and in pills_meta). A click or Enter opens that chat through the sidebar path when it is not the chat the chip sits in or the focused chat (a chat that is not loaded is probed on the host chat's machine first, so a deleted chat is reported, not added), loads the full history when the message is older than the loaded window, falls back to the quote when the id is not found, scrolls the virtualized message list with requestScrollToMessage and flashes the bubble (Tailwind, a steady tint under reduced motion). Since chip-viewer.json the click or Enter opens the chip viewer and this open is its Go to source button; a message or chat that is gone logs at info and the viewer drops the button for a note that its text is what was sent. Pills without ids keep opening by quote. The phones draw chips as labels with no open action; they accept and ignore the new fields.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app draws no chips and has no open action: a sent body is plain text with each pill as [label] (src/shared/pill-body-text.ts), which reads only label, so the new optional fields are ignored.

nativeAndroid.reason: Android draws a sent pill as its label with no open action and has no composer pills. decodeMessagePills (ThreadModels.kt) reads only label and kind, so the new fields are ignored; ThreadEventDecoderTest now feeds them and still passes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No table, column or migration. pills_meta is a JSON text column and the localStorage draft pills are JSON; both gain two optional string fields. Rows and drafts written before keep parsing and open by quote; an older build reading a new row ignores the fields.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop build. No native module, permission, signing, package identity or update channel change; the phones need no release.
